system_prompt_style.note: buildSystemPrompt assembles RLM prompt, subagent guidance, harness state, MCP guidance, context files and skills conditionally. Line numbers not given in the evidence bundle.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Everything is programmatic:** persistent IPython is the built-in model tool; file operations, shell commands, tool use, subagents, and context management happen through code.
env_context_strategy.note: Project context files (e.g. instructions) are appended to the prompt, but no file tree is injected.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Compaction replaces a conversational prefix with a summary and retains the original events in L3 for REPL retrieval.
context_compaction.note: The bash executor truncates output with truncateTail (packages/coding-agent/src/core/bash-executor.ts). The README states that compaction is automatic.

observation_format.note: Text results are certain. Image content types are imported, but the conversion path for images was not seen.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: persistent IPython is the built-in model tool
tool_call_format.note: The ipython tool is called through provider tool calls (toolCall content); its argument is Python code, which is executed as the action.

tool_count.note: The default is ipython only. bash and edit are selectable.

edit_primitive.note: By default edits happen through Python code. An opt-in 'edit' tool exists, but its primitive is not visible in the evidence.

tool_schema_source.note: The tool schema definition files are not in the evidence bundle.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Generic MCP connections are accessed through the pre-imported Python `mcp` object in IPython

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Autonomous mode continues model turns within an explicit budget and evaluates a task-specified end-condition test after each turn.
loop_primitives.note: The default is react via agent-loop.ts with event listeners. Gate-based autonomous mode is opt-in.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Persistent goals:** `/goal` keeps an objective and its progress active across turns until it is completed, paused, or cleared.
planning_granularity.note: The goal is the closest match to a plan object; it is not a task list.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Subagents are built in:** `rlm(...)` spawns real child agents for parallel or background work and returns their results programmatically.
multi_agent_topology.note: Recursion is available by default (allowRecursion ?? true). Nested and peer messaging are also possible.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Calling rlm creates and schedules a subagent session, then returns a stable handle before the subagent completes.
delegation_mechanism.note: A message bus (daemon queues) also exists.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: The interface lets a user inspect history, attach to a session, provide new input, or detach without interrupting execution.
human_in_loop.note: No per-action permission gating is visible. Steering is through the steering queue. Closest value chosen.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Intermediate values persist across turns and remain outside active context until selected.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: stores supplemental prompts, memories, skill descriptions, and reusable subagent specifications as durable state

state_persistence.evidence_quote: prime-agent --resume [path|id]       # Browse sessions or resume one directly

self_verification.note: Opt-in in autonomous mode. /refine is a trajectory review, not output verification.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: A failed test returns bounded output for another attempt; turn, token, and wall-clock limits stop execution.
retry_policy.note: The default interactive session makes one attempt. Autonomous mode (opt-in) retries until the gate passes, within budget.

rollback.evidence_quote: It never rewrites the immutable base system prompt, and recorded snapshots support rollback.
rollback.note: Rollback applies to versioned supplemental harness state (Continual Harness refinement), not to workspace file changes; README advises users to use a disposable clone/worktree they can restore. Closest value; line number not available in excerpt.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: `/autonomous` continues within configured turn, token, and time budgets and can run user-defined quality gates.
termination_condition.note: The default turn ends when the model stops issuing tool calls. The caps apply in autonomous mode.

cost_controls.note: The token budget applies in autonomous mode. Caching is inferred from usage fields.
